testing_gaps: No tests exercise the newly extracted scheduleBackups interval or cron branches (or runScheduledJob registration/error handling); current tests cover interval parsing and one-shot runs, so scheduler wiring regressions could pass unnoticed.

Provider validation coverage only checks the no-provider case and live successful provider integrations; there are no deterministic assertions for blank token values or partial Bitbucket credentials and the resulting error/count behavior in checkJustTokenProvider/checkUserAndPasswordProvider.
No tests assert the startup log output after its provider-specific formatting was factored into helpers, despite the stated requirement to preserve log output.
No tests cover backupStatusTitle's three counter combinations or verify the centralized title is reflected in notification payloads.
